the_blocker.what: the after-break quoted alternatives are written with the optional-CR form inside a character class, where '?' is a LITERAL member of the negated set rather than a quantifier
the_blocker.consequence: a quoted credential continuation containing '?' is not matched by that alternative; because a leading quote is also a delimiter for _AUTH_BARE_VALUE, the whole scheme-split alternative fails and the credential survives
the_blocker.why_it_is_a_blocker_not_a_disclosure: it is unregistered (no oracle row, no rule-table row), while oracle.md C3.4, the source comment and handoff_r3.json's credential_leaks_is_sound_again: true all assert the branch is fail-closed for exactly this shape. Same structure F-REV-R2-01 named: a measured instance closed, a residual class left open, and the exit criterion offered as sound.
the_blocker.fix_belongs_to: r4 -- a new revision, not an edit to r3

the_second_refuted_claim.claim: Claim 8 -- the carrier does not overstate
the_second_refuted_claim.what: handoff_r3.json cites the round 68 state verification as 'overall PASS, idempotent'. Re-running it now gives overall FAIL, with P-7 and P-8 red, because round 70 appended to three of the files whose hashes that verifier pins.
the_second_refuted_claim.generalisation: citing a verification must state its reproducibility premise. A verifier pinned by hashes stops reproducing the moment the files it pins are legitimately appended to -- and it does not error, it just goes red from then on, so 'true at the time' and 'false now' end up behind the same citation.

the_methodological_lesson.what: rounds 68 and 69 built the reproduction from the product's OWN _AUTH_SCHEME_SPLIT constant
the_methodological_lesson.consequence: that construction cannot detect a defect INSIDE that constant -- which is exactly where F-REV-R3-01 lives
the_methodological_lesson.generalisation: a predicate built from a constant taken out of the object under test is immune to that constant. Such a blind spot looks entirely normal: the predicate is faithful, reproducible, and has negative controls.
the_methodological_lesson.evidence_that_this_matters: the self-check reported 8 propositions and 7 negative controls all green; the independent review, on the same day, found a BLOCKER
